title: codeAudit
responsibility: Checks intact verification and matching runtime observations for affected and explicitly requested units at one committed revision.

inputs.name: codeAudit.root
inputs.description: Project filesystem root passed to VerificationStoreRepository, VerificationCheckService, CommitTreeAdapter.open and loadSide. It matters on every call: when no verification record for the commit is found under this root, the function throws, and codeAudit does not validate the value itself.

inputs.name: codeAudit.commit
inputs.description: Git commit whose most recent verification record is selected and re-checked, whose commit tree is opened, and against which the performance measurements are validated. A record for any other commit is never selected, and when none exists for this commit the function throws.

inputs.name: codeAudit.requested
inputs.description: Extra unit IDs added to the affected units; a requested ID with a manifest at this commit is checked by the same performance validator, and one without a manifest fails the scope check instead of throwing. Defaults to an empty array.

outputs.name: codeAudit
outputs.description: Resolves to three TaskCheck entries in this order: 'verification' (always passed, since a failed verification throws first), 'scope' (fails when a requested unit has no manifest at this commit) and 'performance' (fails when any problem is reported, with the problems joined by newlines in its detail).

examples.detail: All declared units exist at this revision.
Current representative latency and memory profiles are recorded.
All declared units exist at this revision.
No affected executable units; runtime profiling is inapplicable to this source change.
Run relevant automated tests for executable task units.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown with 'Run harness verify run; no verification record proves the task commit.' when no stored record has this commit as its source, and with 'Harness verification failed: ' followed by the problems joined with '; ' when the re-check or the stored record's status is not 'passed'. Errors and rejections from the dynamic imports and from the store, check, commit-tree, loader and validator calls are not caught and reach the caller unchanged.
